digest.component_or_area: Jira-family adapter sub-seam and backend contract certification
propositions: ADR 0035 states the first real second backend is out of scope, but Jira Data Center adapter landed before the GitHub adapter, leaving three stale assertions in the ADR that must all be corrected not just Decision item 6

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only if the port is complete and typed; the DC adapter declared 6 TicketTransport members but the core calls 21 distinct transport members, with 12 absent from DC transport and no declared Protocol, causing silent failures and one measured crash (set_entity_property) despite all static signals passing

RemoteRef.instance is presented as an existing deployment-distinction mechanism but is never constructed in production code, only in two test helpers, so must be documented as intended design with the gap named rather than as existing reality

The jira_family sub-seam introduces two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel) and a shared-jira provenance decision deferring generalization (jira_key, jira- prefix, channel vocabulary) to the GitHub adapter epic

DC deployments require least-privilege service account PAT scoped to specific projects with Browse/Create/Edit/Comment/Link permissions, never admin, plus documentation of allow_insecure, ca_bundle, and resolved_statuses configuration options

The March 2029 DC read-only date establishes this as deliberately time-boxed investment for self-hosted clients, making the durable asset the family seam architecture rather than the DC adapter itself
